customer_name: Guangdong Provincial Communications Group Co., Ltd.
business_problem: The group had fragmented driver-facing services, inconsistent user experiences and slow rescue dispatch across a very large expressway network, and it needed a unified travel-service platform for motorists.
solution_summary: Guangdong Provincial Communications Group and Baidu AI Cloud built a unified network travel platform around the group's expressway assets and Baidu's mapping and AI stack. The architecture uses Baidu's high-precision digital base map, navigation SDK and intelligent cloud foundation to consolidate multiple driver-facing apps, mini-programs and public accounts into one service entry point. On top of that shared interface, the team assembled an online highway commerce layer for fuel, charging, retail and roadside services, a differentiated navigation experience driven by transport big data, and a travel-service middle platform that separates common data and business capabilities for reuse across online and offline services. The platform also rebuilt the rescue system so it could combine ETC passage data, vehicle location data and traffic context to compute the best dispatch plan automatically. With the initial platform in place, the next phase adds Qianfan AppBuilder and agent capabilities to create an AI travel assistant that improves interaction quality for motorists.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports the planned AI interaction layer for motorists on top of the travel platform.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the model-development base for future intelligent travel-assistant capabilities.

solution_components.name: Baidu Maps Navigation SDK
solution_components.role: Drives differentiated navigation and route guidance using the group's road-network data.

solution_components.name: Travel Service Middle Platform
solution_components.role: Separates common data and business capabilities for reuse across channels and scenarios.

solution_components.name: AI Travel Assistant
solution_components.role: Adds intelligent interaction and user-experience improvements for motorists on the unified platform.

data_flow: Traffic, ETC and rescue-vehicle location data enter the travel-service middle platform, where mapping and analytics services calculate navigation, commerce and rescue workflows; user reports and service interactions then feed back into the platform to improve dispatch and trip planning.
business_outcome: The group unified its travel-service channels, accelerated rescue dispatch, improved route and service information for drivers and laid the groundwork for an AI assistant on top of the platform.
metrics: Dispatch time was reduced from 5 minutes to 3 minutes.
